maintenance.changeRule: A crawler, purpose class, policy decision, control layer, or rollout rule may change only with an owner, official source, verification method, rollback path, and #714-linked rationale.

policyDefaults.trainingAccessRule: Training access remains blocked or undecided unless product, legal, security, and infrastructure owners explicitly approve a change.
policyDefaults.identityRule: A claimed User-Agent alone is never verified identity; use official IP, reverse-DNS, provider verification, or platform-provided verified bot signals where available.

purposeClasses.description: General search indexing crawlers that discover, crawl, and index public web pages.
purposeClasses.expectedPublicOutcome: Approved public canonical pages, robots.txt, sitemaps, and share assets are reachable unless route policy says otherwise.
purposeClasses.notObservedMeaning: No verified request in the observation window; do not treat as blocked or allowed without crawl evidence.

purposeClasses.description: AI answer or search-reference crawlers that fetch public pages for search results, answers, citations, or grounding.
purposeClasses.expectedPublicOutcome: Approved public content remains reachable for citation/reference use and is measured separately from model-training crawlers.
purposeClasses.notObservedMeaning: No verified AI reference request in the observation window; preserve as not-observed.

purposeClasses.description: Fetchers that retrieve a URL because an end user requested or pasted it into a product.
purposeClasses.expectedPublicOutcome: Approved public pages can be fetched for user-requested previews or answers; private/auth routes remain protected.
purposeClasses.notObservedMeaning: No verified user-triggered fetch in the observation window.

purposeClasses.description: Crawlers or product tokens used to control model training or broad model improvement access.
purposeClasses.expectedPublicOutcome: Existing training restrictions remain unchanged until explicit product/legal/security approval.
purposeClasses.notObservedMeaning: No verified training crawler or policy-token effect in the observation window; do not infer compliance from absence alone.

purposeClasses.description: Preview crawlers that fetch public pages and media when links are shared in social or messaging products.
purposeClasses.expectedPublicOutcome: Approved public pages and absolute HTTPS share images are reachable for rich previews.
purposeClasses.notObservedMeaning: No verified preview request in the observation window.

controlLayers.scope: robots.txt, sitemap declarations, page robots metadata, X-Robots-Tag, status-code behavior
controlLayers.publicEvidence: Fetch robots.txt, sitemap.xml, representative HTML, and headers for each host.

controlLayers.scope: verified bot handling, WAF challenges, rate limits, allowlists, blocks, cache behavior
controlLayers.publicEvidence: Publish aggregate outcome counts only; do not publish rules, IP lists, or raw logs.

controlLayers.scope: Cloudflare, hosting, DNS, routing, and edge policy changes
controlLayers.publicEvidence: Link approved change request or sanitized rollout summary.

controlLayers.scope: cookies, sessions, auth gates, preview protection, write-route protection
controlLayers.publicEvidence: Representative route status and noindex/auth behavior.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Uses robots.txt and Google crawler/fetcher behavior documented by Google.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Google's official reverse DNS and IP verification guidance before treating a request as verified Googlebot.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous robots/CDN rules and confirm Googlebot outcome in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Uses robots.txt and Bing Webmaster crawler behavior documented by Microsoft.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Bing Webmaster Tools or Microsoft's documented IP/rDNS verification before treating a request as verified Bingbot.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous robots/CDN rules and confirm Bingbot outcome in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: OpenAI documents OAI-SearchBot as a search user agent that can be managed separately from GPTBot.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use OpenAI's documented bot source and verified crawler identification before classifying access.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous robots/CDN rules and confirm OAI-SearchBot outcome in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: OpenAI documents user-triggered fetchers separately from automatic crawlers.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Classify only with documented OpenAI identity signals; do not infer from User-Agent alone.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous CDN/auth handling and confirm user-triggered fetch outcomes in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: OpenAI documents GPTBot separately from OAI-SearchBot and user-triggered agents.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use OpenAI's documented bot identity before classifying access.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous training-bot block and confirm no approved policy was widened.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Anthropic documents web access behavior and distinguishes search/reference access from model-training crawlers.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Anthropic's documented crawler identity guidance where available; otherwise record as unverified.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous robots/CDN rules and confirm Claude-SearchBot outcome in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Anthropic documents user-requested fetching separately from broad crawling.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use documented Anthropic identity signals where available; otherwise record as unverified.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous CDN/auth handling and confirm user-triggered fetch outcomes in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Anthropic documents ClaudeBot separately from user-triggered access.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use documented Anthropic identity signals where available; otherwise record as unverified.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous training-bot block and confirm no approved policy was widened.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Perplexity documents crawler/user-agent controls for its bots.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Perplexity's documented identity guidance where available; otherwise record as unverified.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous robots/CDN rules and confirm PerplexityBot outcome in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Perplexity documents user-requested fetch behavior separately from crawler access.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Perplexity's documented identity guidance where available; otherwise record as unverified.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous CDN/auth handling and confirm user-triggered fetch outcomes in aggregate logs.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Google-Extended is a robots.txt product token, not a distinct HTTP User-Agent to classify from access logs.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Do not expect Google-Extended in request logs; verify related Google crawler identity separately and audit robots.txt policy text.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous Google-Extended robots directive and confirm public robots.txt output.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Meta documents its sharing crawler for link previews.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Meta's documented crawler behavior and aggregate edge evidence; preserve unverified requests separately.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous social-preview handling and confirm share preview fetches.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: LinkedIn publishes LinkedInBot in its robots.txt; treat as social/search preview access until product-specific docs say otherwise.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: LinkedIn does not publish a crawler-specific verification method in the cited source; classify matching requests as unverified unless the edge platform supplies a verified-bot signal.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous social-preview handling and confirm LinkedIn preview fetches.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: X/Twitter card metadata must stay fetchable for previews, but this contract does not treat the current generic docs page as crawler-specific Twitterbot verification.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: X/Twitter crawler-specific official token and verification documentation was not confirmed in the cited source; classify matching requests as unverified unless the edge platform supplies a verified-bot signal.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous social-preview handling and confirm X/Twitter card fetches.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Slack documents link-expanding robots that fetch metadata and media for shared URLs.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Use Slack's documented User-Agent plus aggregate edge evidence; preserve unverified requests separately.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous social-preview handling and confirm Slack unfurl fetches.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Discord link preview behavior must be treated as social-preview fetching, not indexing or training.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Discord does not publish a crawler-specific verification method in the cited source; classify matching requests as unverified unless the edge platform supplies a verified-bot signal.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous social-preview handling and confirm Discord embed fetches.

crawlerAgents.robotsBehavior: Telegram link previews are treated operationally as social-preview fetching, but this contract does not treat the Bot API page as crawler-specific TelegramBot verification.
crawlerAgents.identityVerification: Telegram crawler-specific official token and verification documentation was not confirmed in the cited source; classify matching requests as unverified unless the edge platform supplies a verified-bot signal.
crawlerAgents.rollback: Restore previous social-preview handling and confirm Telegram preview fetches.

preflight: fetch current robots and representative public routes
rollout.rollbackProcedure: Revert the owning application or infrastructure rule, confirm representative robots/route output, and record aggregate crawler outcome evidence without publishing raw logs.
rollout.incidentRule: If a rule exposes private, transactional, preview, or staging content, treat it as a security incident and roll back before further SEO/GEO changes.
